selection_methodology.previous_slice_boundary_rule: Slice 3 ends on 2025-08-11; Slice 4 begins with the next eligible frozen-denominator alert-start date.
selection_methodology.start_rule: Start at the earliest Zaporizhzhia denominator alert-start date after Slice 3 that is not already assigned to Slice 0/1/2/3.
selection_methodology.stop_rule: Add complete chronological Europe/Kyiv alert-start dates among eligible episodes until the unique eligible episode count first reaches at least 170 without exceeding 200.
selection_methodology.eligibility_rule: Exclude any episode already present in Slice 0, Slice 1, Slice 2 or Slice 3; preserve complete alert-start dates among eligible episodes.
